title: Validate packed RNN batch sizes before backend dispatch
body:
## Issue

Fixes ROCm/TheRock#8337.

## Summary

Validate packed RNN batch_sizes at the shared ATen entry points before selecting cuDNN/MIOpen or the native implementation. This preserves the CPU-only contract when backend capability probing falls back to the native PackedLayer and prevents it from dereferencing device memory on the host.

Extend the existing regression test to cover both the normal backend dispatch and the native fallback forced by disabling the cuDNN/MIOpen backend.

## Testing

- spin quicklint
- Full editable ROCm build for gfx1201
- python test/test_cuda.py -k test_rnn_packed_sequence_batch_sizes_must_be_cpu

The focused test passes on Linux with ROCm 7.2 and gfx1201. Windows ROCm CI is required to validate the original Windows access-violation environment.

## Checklist

- [x] Passes lint (spin quicklint)
- [x] Added/updated tests
- [x] Updated documentation (not applicable)
- [x] Included benchmark results (not applicable; validation-only change)
